  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  a.CITY,
  a.STATE,
  a.POSTAL_CODE
FROM master_dept_hierarchy m
JOIN fclt_building_address a
  ON m.DLC_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY OR m.DLC_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY /* preserve intent: link via building key if DLC_KEY holds building key */

WITH section_format_and_enrollment AS (
  SELECT
    cso.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID,
    cso.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    TRIM(BOTH '|' FROM CONCAT(
      CASE WHEN cso.IS_LECTURE_SECTION IS NOT NULL AND cso.IS_LECTURE_SECTION <> '' AND UPPER(cso.IS_LECTURE_SECTION) NOT IN ('0','FALSE','N') THEN '|LECTURE' ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN cso.IS_LAB_SECTION IS NOT NULL AND cso.IS_LAB_SECTION <> '' AND UPPER(cso.IS_LAB_SECTION) NOT IN ('0','FALSE','N') THEN '|LAB' ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN cso.IS_RECITATION_SECTION IS NOT NULL AND cso.IS_RECITATION_SECTION <> '' AND UPPER(cso.IS_RECITATION_SECTION) NOT IN ('0','FALSE','N') THEN '|RECITATION' ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN cso.IS_DESIGN_SECTION IS NOT NULL AND cso.IS_DESIGN_SECTION <> '' AND UPPER(cso.IS_DESIGN_SECTION) NOT IN ('0','FALSE','N') THEN '|DESIGN' ELSE '' END
    )) AS FORMATS
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cso
  WHERE cso.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL
),
course_offering_sections AS (
  SELECT
    cc.TERM_CODE,
    cc.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    cc.SECTION_ID,
    cc.MEET_PLACE,
    cc.MEET_TIME,
    cc.SUBJECT_ID
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cc
  WHERE cc.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND cc.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
    AND cc.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
),
building_address_street AS (
  -- normalize building key/number relationships and restrict to street addresses
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    a.STREET_NAME AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
    a.CITY,
    a.STATE,
    a.POSTAL_CODE,
    a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  FROM buildings b
  LEFT JOIN fclt_building_address a
    ON (a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY OR a.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER)
  WHERE a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
)
SELECT
  cos.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  cos.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  so.MEET_PLACE AS ROOM,
  COALESCE(fr.FLOOR, fr.FLOOR) AS FLOOR,
  COALESCE(fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bld.BUILDING_KEY) AS BUILDING_KEY,
  COALESCE(bas.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, bld.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, bas.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS) AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  bas.CITY AS CITY,
  bas.STATE AS STATE,
  bas.POSTAL_CODE AS POSTAL_CODE,
  COALESCE(sfae.FORMATS, '') AS FORMATS,
  so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM course_offering_sections cos
JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered ccs
  ON cos.SECTION_ID = ccs.SECTION_ID
  AND cos.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN subject_offered so
  ON cos.SECTION_ID = so.SECTION_ID
  AND cos.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN section_format_and_enrollment sfae
  ON cos.SECTION_ID = sfae.SECTION_ID

LEFT JOIN fclt_rooms fr
  ON cos.MEET_PLACE = fr.BUILDING_ROOM
LEFT JOIN buildings bld
  ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bld.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN building_address_street bas
  ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bas.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 300
GROUP BY
  cos.TERM_CODE,
  cos.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  so.MEET_PLACE,
  fr.FLOOR,
  COALESCE(fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bld.BUILDING_KEY),
  COALESCE(bas.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, bld.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS),
  bas.CITY,
  bas.STATE,
  bas.POSTAL_CODE,
  COALESCE(sfae.FORMATS, ''),
  so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
ORDER BY cos.TERM_CODE, cos.SUBJECT_TITLE

rows.question: What are the subject titles, their material titles, ISBN numbers, and total costs of new materials for each subject title?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH course_subjects_projection AS (
SELECT
  c.`SUBJECT_ID` AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
  c.`SUBJECT_TITLE` AS `SUBJECT_TITLE`
FROM `cis_course_catalog` c
)
SELECT
  csp.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  mr.MATERIAL_TITLE,
  mr.ISBN,
  mr.TOTAL_NEW_COST
FROM
  course_subjects_projection AS csp
JOIN
  (
    -- TIP materials: join tip_material to tip_detail (tip_detail is a base table)
    SELECT
      td.SUBJECT_ID,
      tm.TITLE AS MATERIAL_TITLE,
      tm.ISBN AS ISBN,
      CASE
        WHEN tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE IS NOT NULL AND td.RECORD_COUNT IS NOT NULL
          THEN tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE * td.RECORD_COUNT
        ELSE NULL
      END AS TOTAL_NEW_COST
    FROM tip_material tm
    JOIN tip_detail td ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY

    UNION ALL

    -- Library reserve catalog materials: catalog linked from library_reserve_matrl_detail
    SELECT
      lmd.SUBJECT_ID,
      lrc.CATALOG_TITLE AS MATERIAL_TITLE,
      lrc.CATALOG_ISBN AS ISBN,
      NULL AS TOTAL_NEW_COST
    FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lmd
    JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc ON lmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  ) AS mr
  ON mr.SUBJECT_ID = csp.SUBJECT_ID
ORDER BY
  csp.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  mr.MATERIAL_TITLE

  COALESCE(cc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, so.TERM_CODE, id.TERM_CODE) AS academic_year,

rows.question: For each sponsor of the independent activity periods, list the sponsor name, number of sessions held, the total number of enrollment, the minimum and maximum fee, the number of sessions with info, and the number of sessions without info.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  s.`SPONSOR_NAME` AS sponsor_name,
  COUNT(*) AS session_count,
  SUM(COALESCE(s.`ATTENDANCE_NUM`,0)) AS total_enrollment,
  MIN(s.`FEE`) AS min_fee,
  MAX(s.`FEE`) AS max_fee,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.`HAS_SESSION_INFO` = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sessions_with_info,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.`HAS_SESSION_INFO` = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sessions_without_info
FROM (
  -- base session rows with sponsor and canonicalized measures
  SELECT
    iapd.`IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY`,
    iaps.`SPONSOR_NAME`,
    iaps.`SPONSOR_TYPE`,
    iapd.`TERM_CODE`,
    iapd.`ACTIVITY_TITLE`,
    iapd.`ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION`,
    -- ATTENDANCE in iap_subject_detail is textual; copy to numeric estimate column ATTENDANCE_NUM.
    -- If ATTENDANCE contains a numeric value, cast it; otherwise NULL.
    CASE
      WHEN iapd.`ATTENDANCE` REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(iapd.`ATTENDANCE` AS SIGNED)
      WHEN iapd.`ATTENDANCE` REGEXP '^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(iapd.`ATTENDANCE` AS DECIMAL(10,2))
      ELSE NULL
    END AS ATTENDANCE_NUM,
    -- fee is already numeric in schema
    iapd.`FEE` AS FEE,
    -- HAS_SESSION_INFO comes from iap_subject_session table; normalize to 'Y'/'N'/NULL
    CASE
      WHEN iss.`HAS_SESSION_INFO` IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN TRIM(UPPER(iss.`HAS_SESSION_INFO`)) IN ('Y','YES','1','TRUE','T') THEN 'Y'
      WHEN TRIM(UPPER(iss.`HAS_SESSION_INFO`)) IN ('N','NO','0','FALSE','F') THEN 'N'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS HAS_SESSION_INFO
  FROM `iap_subject_detail` AS iapd
  LEFT JOIN `iap_subject_sponsor` AS iaps
    ON iapd.`IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY` = iaps.`IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY`
  -- join to session info to obtain HAS_SESSION_INFO if present; match on term and (approx) activity title via session key if available.
  LEFT JOIN `iap_subject_session` AS iss
    ON iss.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY` = iapd.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`
  WHERE
    -- restrict to rows that belong to IAP terms (term code or indicates IAP)
    (iapd.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND (UPPER(iapd.`TERM_CODE`) LIKE 'IAP%' OR UPPER(iapd.`TERM_CODE`) = 'IAP'))
) AS s
WHERE
  s.`SPONSOR_NAME` IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.`SPONSOR_NAME`) <> ''
GROUP BY
  s.`SPONSOR_NAME`
ORDER BY
  s.`SPONSOR_NAME`

  FROM `iap_subject_detail` d

    -- only include rows that are actually IAP offerings: prefer explicit flag if present

term_descriptions AS (

    COALESCE(at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, ata.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`) AS TERM_DESCRIPTION

SELECT
  COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, iss.SESSION_LOCATION) AS BUILDING_NAME,
  iss.SESSION_LOCATION AS LOCATION,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(ccso.SUBJECT_ID, cis.SUBJECT_ID, csso.SECTION_ID, isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY)) AS NUM_SUBJECTS,
  SUM(COALESCE(isd.FEE,0)) AS TOTAL_FEE,
  MIN(sd.duration_minutes) AS SHORTEST_SESSION_DURATION_MINUTES,
  MAX(sd.duration_minutes) AS LONGEST_SESSION_DURATION_MINUTES
FROM iap_subject_detail isd
JOIN iap_subject_session iss
  ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered csso
  ON csso.MEET_PLACE = iss.SESSION_LOCATION
LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered ccso
  ON ccso.SECTION_ID = csso.SECTION_ID
LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog cis
  ON cis.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = ccso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms fr
  ON fr.SPACE_ID = iss.SESSION_LOCATION
LEFT JOIN buildings b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  -- compute session duration in minutes, tolerant of times like '930AM' or '09:30AM' or '9:30AM'
  SELECT
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    -- parse start and end into TIME values then compute minutes difference, assuming same-day sessions
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(
      MINUTE,
      STR_TO_DATE(
        CASE
          WHEN SESSION_START_TIME REGEXP '^[0-9]{3,4}[APap][Mm]$'
            THEN INSERT(SESSION_START_TIME, LENGTH(SESSION_START_TIME)-1, 0, ':')
          ELSE SESSION_START_TIME
        END,
        '%l:%i%p'
      ),
      STR_TO_DATE(
        CASE
          WHEN SESSION_END_TIME REGEXP '^[0-9]{3,4}[APap][Mm]$'
            THEN INSERT(SESSION_END_TIME, LENGTH(SESSION_END_TIME)-1, 0, ':')
          ELSE SESSION_END_TIME
        END,
        '%l:%i%p'
      )
    ) AS duration_minutes
  FROM iap_subject_session
  WHERE SESSION_START_TIME IS NOT NULL
    AND SESSION_START_TIME <> ''
    AND SESSION_END_TIME IS NOT NULL
    AND SESSION_END_TIME <> ''
) sd
  ON sd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
WHERE iss.SESSION_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
  AND iss.SESSION_LOCATION <> ''
  AND LOWER(iss.SESSION_LOCATION) NOT LIKE '%online%'
  AND LOWER(iss.SESSION_LOCATION) NOT LIKE '%zoom%'
GROUP BY COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, iss.SESSION_LOCATION), iss.SESSION_LOCATION
ORDER BY COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, iss.SESSION_LOCATION), iss.SESSION_LOCATION

rows.question: What is total number of subjects, the total fee, and the shortest and longest sessions, for all virtual IAP sessions?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH virtual_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    s.SESSION_DATE,
    s.SESSION_START_TIME,
    s.SESSION_END_TIME,
    s.SESSION_LOCATION
  FROM iap_subject_session s
  WHERE (
    LOWER(COALESCE(s.SESSION_LOCATION, '')) LIKE '%virtual%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.SESSION_LOCATION, '')) LIKE '%online%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.SESSION_LOCATION, '')) LIKE '%zoom%'
  )
  -- keep only rows with non-null start and end times
  AND s.SESSION_START_TIME IS NOT NULL
  AND s.SESSION_END_TIME IS NOT NULL
),
-- parse times and compute durations in minutes, handling end before start as next-day
session_durations AS (
  SELECT
    vs.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    vs.SESSION_DATE,
    vs.SESSION_START_TIME,
    vs.SESSION_END_TIME,
    vs.SESSION_LOCATION,
    STR_TO_DATE(vs.SESSION_START_TIME, '%l%i%p') AS start_dt,
    STR_TO_DATE(vs.SESSION_END_TIME, '%l%i%p') AS end_dt,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(
      MINUTE,
      STR_TO_DATE(vs.SESSION_START_TIME, '%l%i%p'),
      CASE
        WHEN STR_TO_DATE(vs.SESSION_END_TIME, '%l%i%p') >= STR_TO_DATE(vs.SESSION_START_TIME, '%l%i%p')
          THEN STR_TO_DATE(vs.SESSION_END_TIME, '%l%i%p')
        ELSE DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(vs.SESSION_END_TIME, '%l%i%p'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
      END
    ) AS duration_minutes
  FROM virtual_sessions vs
  -- filter out rows where parsing failed (NULL start_dt or end_dt)
  WHERE STR_TO_DATE(vs.SESSION_START_TIME, '%l%i%p') IS NOT NULL
    AND STR_TO_DATE(vs.SESSION_END_TIME, '%l%i%p') IS NOT NULL
),
-- identify IAP-detail records that link to those virtual sessions; keep only numeric fees
iap_virtual_details AS (
  SELECT
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY,
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY,
    d.ACTIVITY_TITLE,
    d.ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION,
    d.TERM_CODE,
    d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE,
    d.MAX_ENROLLMENT,
    d.ATTENDANCE,
    d.PREREQUISITES,
    d.FEE,
    d.FEE_REASON,
    d.PREREG_DEADLINE,
    d.CREATE_DATE,
    d.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE,
    d.IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION,
    d.IS_CANCELLED,
    d.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
    sd.duration_minutes
  FROM iap_subject_detail d
  JOIN session_durations sd
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = sd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(d.TERM_CODE, '')) = 'IAP'
    AND d.FEE IS NOT NULL
),
-- Count distinct SUBJECT_IDs from subject_offered that are in TERM_CODE = 'IAP' and are associated with at least one virtual session.
-- Because there is no direct reliable FK between iap_subject_detail and subject_offered in schema, we use subject_summary and subject_offered_summary where TERM_CODE='IAP'
-- and assume subjects that appear in subject_summary/subject_offered_summary for TERM_CODE 'IAP' are the offered subjects for IAP; then restrict to those terms that have virtual sessions present.
iap_terms_with_virtual AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.TERM_CODE
  FROM iap_virtual_details d
),
subject_ids_for_iap AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID
  FROM subject_summary ss
  WHERE ss.TERM_CODE IN (SELECT TERM_CODE FROM iap_terms_with_virtual)
    AND ss.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
),
-- final aggregates for durations and fees
durations_agg AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(duration_minutes) AS shortest_minutes,
    MAX(duration_minutes) AS longest_minutes
  FROM session_durations sd
  JOIN iap_subject_detail d ON sd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(d.TERM_CODE, '')) = 'IAP'
),
total_fee AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(FEE), 0) AS total_fee
  FROM iap_virtual_details
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subject_ids_for_iap), 0) AS total_subjects,
  COALESCE((SELECT total_fee FROM total_fee), 0) AS total_fee,
  COALESCE((SELECT shortest_minutes FROM durations_agg), 0) AS shortest_session_duration_minutes,
  COALESCE((SELECT longest_minutes FROM durations_agg), 0) AS longest_session_duration_minutes

WITH department_phones AS (
  -- collect phone numbers tied to a department code from available directory tables
  SELECT
    w.UNIT_ID AS department_code,
    w.OFFICE_PHONE AS office_phone
  FROM warehouse_users w
  WHERE w.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND w.OFFICE_PHONE <> '' AND w.UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND w.UNIT_ID <> ''

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    e.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER AS department_code,
    e.OFFICE_PHONE AS office_phone
  FROM employee_directory e
  WHERE e.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND e.OFFICE_PHONE <> '' AND e.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND e.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER <> ''

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    NULL AS department_code, -- drupal_employee_directory has no reliable department code column in this schema
    d.OFFICE_PHONE AS office_phone
  FROM drupal_employee_directory d
  WHERE d.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND d.OFFICE_PHONE <> ''
),
sis_courses_filtered AS (
  -- get SIS courses with department info and course level; exclude rows without department code/name
  SELECT
    sc.COURSE AS course,
    sc.COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level,
    sc.DEPARTMENT AS department_code,
    sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
    sd.SCHOOL_CODE AS school_code,
    sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name
  FROM sis_course_description sc
  LEFT JOIN sis_department sd
    ON sc.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT IS NOT NULL AND sc.DEPARTMENT <> ''
    AND sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> ''
),
departments_offering AS (
  -- distinct departments (with school info) that offer SIS courses
  SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(s.school_code, '') AS school_code,
    NULLIF(COALESCE(s.school_name, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ''), '') AS school_name,
    s.department_code,
    s.department_name
  FROM (
    SELECT
      department_code,
      department_name,
      school_code,
      school_name
    FROM (
      SELECT
        department_code,
        department_name,
        school_code,
        school_name
      FROM (
        SELECT
          department_code,
          department_name,
          school_code,
          school_name
        FROM (
          SELECT
            department_code,
            department_name,
            school_code,
            school_name
          FROM sis_courses_filtered
        ) t
      ) u
    ) v
  ) s
  LEFT JOIN sis_department sd
    ON s.department_code = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
phones_per_dept AS (
  -- count distinct non-empty phone numbers per department_code
  SELECT
    department_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT office_phone) AS phone_number_count
  FROM department_phones
  WHERE department_code IS NOT NULL AND department_code <> ''
    AND office_phone IS NOT NULL AND office_phone <> ''
  GROUP BY department_code
),
level_counts AS (
  -- count U/G per department from SIS courses (ignore other/NULL)
  SELECT
    department_code,
    course_level,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM sis_courses_filtered
  WHERE course_level IN ('U','G')
  GROUP BY department_code, course_level
),
max_counts AS (
  SELECT
    department_code,
    MAX(cnt) AS max_cnt
  FROM level_counts
  GROUP BY department_code
),
most_common_levels AS (
  -- if tie, return comma-separated alphabetical order
  SELECT
    lc.department_code,
    GROUP_CONCAT(lc.course_level ORDER BY lc.course_level SEPARATOR ',') AS most_common_course_level
  FROM level_counts lc
  JOIN max_counts mc
    ON lc.department_code = mc.department_code
   AND lc.cnt = mc.max_cnt
  GROUP BY lc.department_code
)
SELECT
  d.school_code AS school_code,
  NULLIF(d.school_name, '') AS school_name,
  d.department_code AS department_code,
  d.department_name AS department_name,
  COALESCE(p.phone_number_count, 0) AS phone_number_count,
  -- if no U/G courses for the department, most_common_course_level should be NULL
  m.most_common_course_level AS most_common_course_level
FROM departments_offering d
LEFT JOIN phones_per_dept p
  ON d.department_code = p.department_code
LEFT JOIN most_common_levels m
  ON d.department_code = m.department_code
ORDER BY
  d.school_code ASC,
  d.department_code ASC

    COALESCE(NULLIF(dcc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ''), NULLIF(cis.DEPARTMENT_CODE, '')) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE

    ON cis.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = dcc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
    AND cis.SUBJECT_ID = dcc.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN fclt_organization fo
    ON fo.ORGANIZATION = COALESCE(NULLIF(dcc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ''), NULLIF(cis.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ''))
  WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(dcc.SUBJECT_ID, ''), NULLIF(dcc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, '')) IS NOT NULL

-- canonicalize subject rows from all SIS sources (at least CIS, course_catalog_subject_offered, drupal)
sis_subject_row_level AS (
  SELECT
    DISTINCT
    NULLIF(s.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, '') AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    NULLIF(s.SUBJECT_ID, '') AS SUBJECT_ID,
    NULLIF(s.SUBJECT_CODE, '') AS SUBJECT_CODE,
    NULLIF(s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, '') AS SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    NULLIF(s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, '') AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    NULLIF(s.SCHOOL_CODE, '') AS SCHOOL_CODE,

  CASE WHEN ss.SUBJECT_CODE REGEXP '^[Gg]' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS GRADUATE_LEVEL,

    MAX(ss.SUBJECT_NUMBER)
  ) AS MAX_COURSE_NUMBER,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS TOTAL_DEPARTMENTS_OFFERING_SUBJECTS
FROM sis_subject_row_level ss

GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_CODE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.DLC_KEY, CASE WHEN ss.SUBJECT_CODE REGEXP '^[Gg]' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END

rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  bcc.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_component, -- using BUILDING_NUMBER as the "building component" identifier
  bc.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,         -- source: buildings.BUILDING_NAME
  COALESCE(bc.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, bc.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS square_footage, -- source: buildings.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE else BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
  COALESCE(floor_ct.total_floors, NULL) AS total_floors,   -- source: fac_floor.FLOOR_KEY (COUNT DISTINCT)
  COALESCE(room_ct.total_rooms, NULL) AS total_rooms,      -- source: fac_rooms.FAC_ROOM_KEY (COUNT DISTINCT)
  COALESCE(org_ct.total_facility_organizations, NULL) AS total_facility_organizations, -- source: fac_organization.ORGANIZATION_KEY (COUNT DISTINCT by building via fac_rooms join)
  NULL AS total_supervisors,   -- no supervisor identifier in schema (space_supervisor_usage has MIT_ID but not linked to building), so left NULL per spec
  NULL AS total_supervisees    -- no supervisee identifiers linked to building in schema, so left NULL per spec
FROM (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    BUILDING_NUMBER,
    BUILDING_NAME,
    BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM buildings
) AS bc
-- cohort keyed by building to expose BUILDING_NUMBER as component identifier (keeps BUILDING_KEY)
JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    BUILDING_NUMBER,
    BUILDING_NAME
  FROM buildings
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_NUMBER, BUILDING_NAME
) AS bcc
  ON bcc.BUILDING_KEY = bc.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  -- count distinct floors by BUILDING_KEY using fac_floor.FLOOR_KEY
  SELECT BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FLOOR_KEY) AS total_floors
  FROM fac_floor
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) AS floor_ct
  ON floor_ct.BUILDING_KEY = bc.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  -- count distinct rooms by BUILDING_KEY using fac_rooms.FAC_ROOM_KEY
  SELECT BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms
  FROM fac_rooms
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) AS room_ct
  ON room_ct.BUILDING_KEY = bc.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  -- count distinct facility organizations associated with the building.
  -- fac_rooms has ORGANIZATION_KEY and BUILDING_KEY, so count distinct ORGANIZATION_KEY per BUILDING_KEY.
  SELECT BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_facility_organizations
  FROM fac_rooms
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) AS org_ct
  ON org_ct.BUILDING_KEY = bc.BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY bcc.BUILDING_NUMBER

rows.question: What is the DLC key, name of the DLC, total number of floors, total square footage, total number of facility organizations, total number of supervisors, total number of supervisees, and total building heights for each building?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH buildings_base AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    BUILDING_NAME,
    BUILDING_NUMBER,
    BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
  FROM buildings
  WHERE BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(BUILDING_KEY) <> ''
),
floors_by_building AS (
  SELECT
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) AS floor_count
  FROM fclt_floor
  WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) <> ''
  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
orgs_by_building AS (
  -- facility organizations (DLCs) associated with building via rooms' FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  SELECT
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS fac_org_count
  FROM fclt_rooms
  WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) <> ''
  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
supervisor_metrics_by_building AS (
  -- Try to map supervisor usage by matching space_supervisor_usage.DEPT_NAMES to rooms.DEPT_CODE or rooms.ORGANIZATION_NAME.
  -- If no reliable mapping exists in the data, this will yield zeros per requirement.
  SELECT
    r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(COALESCE(ss.DEPT_COUNT,0)) AS total_supervisors,
    SUM(COALESCE(ss.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES,0)) AS total_supervisees
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, DEPT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME
    FROM fclt_rooms
    WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) <> ''
  ) r
  LEFT JOIN space_supervisor_usage ss
    ON (
         ss.DEPT_NAMES IS NOT NULL
         AND TRIM(ss.DEPT_NAMES) <> ''
         AND (
           ss.DEPT_NAMES = r.DEPT_CODE
           OR ss.DEPT_NAMES = r.ORGANIZATION_NAME
         )
       )
  GROUP BY r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
building_height_by_building AS (
  -- Sum BUILDING_HEIGHT from fclt_building where FCLT_BUILDING_KEY matches.
  -- BUILDING_HEIGHT may be non-numeric; only sum numeric-looking values.
  SELECT
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN BUILDING_HEIGHT IS NULL THEN 0
        WHEN TRIM(BUILDING_HEIGHT) = '' THEN 0
        WHEN BUILDING_HEIGHT REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(BUILDING_HEIGHT AS DECIMAL(18,4))
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS total_building_height
  FROM fclt_building
  WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) <> ''
  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
)
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,                                    -- DLC key requested mapped to building key per spec
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,                                  -- name of the DLC / building
  COALESCE(f.floor_count, 0) AS TOTAL_FLOORS,
  COALESCE(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, 0) AS TOTAL_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  COALESCE(o.fac_org_count, 0) AS TOTAL_FACILITY_ORGANIZATIONS,
  COALESCE(s.total_supervisors, 0) AS TOTAL_SUPERVISORS,
  COALESCE(s.total_supervisees, 0) AS TOTAL_SUPERVISEES,
  COALESCE(h.total_building_height, 0) AS TOTAL_BUILDING_HEIGHT
FROM buildings_base b
LEFT JOIN floors_by_building f ON f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN orgs_by_building o ON o.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN supervisor_metrics_by_building s ON s.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN building_height_by_building h ON h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY b.BUILDING_KEY ASC

WITH
-- enrollment per department from the most reliable available tables.
dept_enrollment AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUM(COALESCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0)) AS total_enrolled
  FROM (
    SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
    FROM subject_offered_summary
    WHERE OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
    FROM library_subject_offered
    WHERE OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULLIF(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,0) AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
    FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL
  ) src
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
-- map TIP subject offerings to their materials and rental_new_price (cast once)
tip_with_price AS (
  SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    tso.SUBJECT_ID,
    CASE
      WHEN m.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE IS NULL OR TRIM(m.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST(m.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE AS SIGNED)
    END AS RENTAL_NEW_PRICE
  FROM tip_subject_offered tso
  LEFT JOIN tip_detail td
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN tip_material m
    ON m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NOT NULL
),
-- aggregate TIP stats per department
tip_stats AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS tip_subject_count,
    MIN(RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS min_rental_new_price,
    MAX(RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS max_rental_new_price
  FROM tip_with_price
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
-- ensure departments that have TIP subjects but no materials still show up
tip_subjects_only AS (
  SELECT
    OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS tip_subject_count
  FROM tip_subject_offered
  WHERE OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME
),
-- union of all departments seen in either source
all_departments AS (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM tip_stats
  UNION
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM tip_subjects_only
  UNION
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM dept_enrollment
)
SELECT
  ad.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  COALESCE(ts.tip_subject_count, tso.tip_subject_count, 0) AS tip_subject_type_count,
  COALESCE(de.total_enrolled, 0) AS total_enrolled_students,
  ts.min_rental_new_price,
  ts.max_rental_new_price
FROM all_departments ad
LEFT JOIN tip_stats ts
  ON ad.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME
LEFT JOIN tip_subjects_only tso
  ON ad.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.DEPARTMENT_NAME
LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment de
  ON ad.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.DEPARTMENT_NAME
ORDER BY ad.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH course_material_row_level AS (
  SELECT
    cis.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
    course_catalog.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID,
    drupal.SECTION_ID AS drupal_SECTION_ID,
    drupal.SUBJECT_ID AS drupal_SUBJECT_ID,

    libcat.CATALOG_TITLE AS CATALOG_TITLE,
    libmatstat.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS,
    tipmatstat.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS,
    tip.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY AS TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
    tip.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    tip.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
    -- prefer course_catalog then tip_subject_offered then drupal for school name
    COALESCE(course_catalog.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, tipso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, drupal.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
    -- carry an id usable to count distinct course types
    COALESCE(course_catalog.SECTION_ID, tipso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, drupal.SECTION_ID) AS course_type_id
  FROM cis_course_catalog AS cis
  LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered AS course_catalog
    ON cis.SUBJECT_ID = course_catalog.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog AS drupal
    ON drupal.SUBJECT_ID = cis.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN tip_subject_offered AS tipso
    ON tipso.SUBJECT_ID = cis.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN tip_detail AS tip
    ON tipso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tip.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN tip_material AS tipm
    ON tip.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tipm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog AS libcat
    ON libcat.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = tip.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_material_status AS libmatstat
    ON libmatstat.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tip.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  LEFT JOIN tip_material_status AS tipmatstat
    ON tipmatstat.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tip.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  WHERE
    (
      (tipm.AUTHOR IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(tipm.AUTHOR) <> '')
      OR
      (libcat.CATALOG_AUTHOR_NAME IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(libcat.CATALOG_AUTHOR_NAME) <> '')
    )
),
split_authors AS (
  SELECT
    cmr.*,
    TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(
      SUBSTRING_INDEX(
        COALESCE(NULLIF(cmr.AUTHOR,''), cmr.CATALOG_AUTHOR_NAME),
        ';',
        author_pos.n
      ),
      ';',
      -1
    )) AS author_part
  FROM course_material_row_level cmr
  JOIN (
    SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
    UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
  ) AS author_pos
    ON author_pos.n <= 1 + (
      LENGTH(COALESCE(NULLIF(cmr.AUTHOR,''), cmr.CATALOG_AUTHOR_NAME))
      - LENGTH(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(cmr.AUTHOR,''), cmr.CATALOG_AUTHOR_NAME), ';', ''))
    )
)
SELECT
  author_part AS AUTHOR,
  COALESCE(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, '') AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  COALESCE(LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, '') AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
  COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_RECORDS,
  COUNT(DISTINCT course_type_id) AS TOTAL_COURSE_TYPES
FROM split_authors
WHERE author_part IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(author_part) <> ''
GROUP BY author_part, COALESCE(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ''), COALESCE(LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, '')
ORDER BY author_part, SCHOOL_NAME

rows.question: For the 2023 Fall term, what are the unique term descriptions, subject titles along with their prerequisites, total number of types of subjects per term code, instructor of this course, and the number of types of courses ever taught by the instructor?

WITH target_terms AS (
  SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION
  FROM academic_term_parameter
  WHERE TERM_CODE LIKE '2023%'
    AND RIGHT(TERM_CODE,2) IN ('FA','JA','SP','SU')
),
-- subjects with prerequisites and instructor info from course catalog tables (prefer drupal then course_catalog_subject_offered then cis_course_catalog)
subjects_prereq AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(d.SO_TERM_CODE, c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, ci.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, so.TERM_CODE) AS TERM_CODE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d.SUBJECT_TITLE,''), NULLIF(c.SUBJECT_TITLE,''), NULLIF(ci.SUBJECT_TITLE,''), NULLIF(so.SUBJECT_TITLE,'')) AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d.PREREQUISITES,''), NULLIF(c.PREREQUISITES,''), NULLIF(ci.PREREQUISITES,'')) AS PREREQUISITES,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,''), NULLIF(c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,''), NULLIF(so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,'')) AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,''), NULLIF(c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,''), NULLIF(so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,'')) AS INSTRUCTOR_ID,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d.SUBJECT_ID,''), NULLIF(c.SUBJECT_ID,''), NULLIF(ci.SUBJECT_ID,''), NULLIF(so.SUBJECT_ID,'')) AS SUBJECT_ID
  FROM drupal_course_catalog d
  LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered c ON d.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID AND d.SO_TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog ci ON d.SUBJECT_ID = ci.SUBJECT_ID AND d.SO_TERM_CODE = ci.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN subject_offered so ON d.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID AND d.SO_TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
  WHERE d.SO_TERM_CODE LIKE '2023%' AND RIGHT(d.SO_TERM_CODE,2) = 'FA'
),
-- unique subject titles and prerequisites for 2023 Fall
unique_subjects AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    sp.TERM_CODE,
    sp.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    sp.PREREQUISITES,
    sp.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
    sp.INSTRUCTOR_ID,
    sp.SUBJECT_ID
  FROM subjects_prereq sp
  WHERE RIGHT(sp.TERM_CODE,2) = 'FA' AND LEFT(sp.TERM_CODE,4) = '2023'
),
-- count of distinct subject types per term code (subject types interpreted as SUBJECT_ID)
types_per_term AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS NUM_SUBJECT_TYPES
  FROM subject_offered
  WHERE TERM_CODE LIKE '2023%' AND RIGHT(TERM_CODE,2) = 'FA'
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE
),
-- number of distinct course types ever taught by instructor (across all terms in subject_offered)
instructor_course_types AS (
  SELECT
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS INSTRUCTOR_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.COURSE_NUMBER) AS NUM_COURSE_TYPES_EVER
  FROM subject_offered so
  WHERE so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID <> ''
  GROUP BY so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
)
SELECT
  ut.TERM_CODE,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  ut.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  ut.PREREQUISITES,
  ut.INSTRUCTOR_NAME AS INSTRUCTOR,
  COALESCE(tpt.NUM_SUBJECT_TYPES, 0) AS TOTAL_SUBJECT_TYPES_IN_TERM,
  COALESCE(ict.NUM_COURSE_TYPES_EVER, 0) AS NUM_COURSE_TYPES_EVER_BY_INSTRUCTOR
FROM unique_subjects ut
LEFT JOIN academic_term_parameter at ON ut.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN types_per_term tpt ON ut.TERM_CODE = tpt.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN instructor_course_types ict ON ut.INSTRUCTOR_ID = ict.INSTRUCTOR_ID
ORDER BY ut.TERM_CODE, ut.SUBJECT_TITLE

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT,
  -- Use street address from buildings if present, otherwise from address source (fac_building has no explicit street columns in DDL)
  NULLIF(b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, '') AS STREET_ADDRESS,
  addr.CITY,
  addr.STATE,
  addr.ZIP AS POSTAL_CODE,
  b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  r.MIN_FLOOR_LEVEL,
  r.MAX_FLOOR_LEVEL,
  r.TOTAL_ROOM_AREA
FROM buildings b
LEFT JOIN (
  -- fac_building may carry building height; join by BUILDING_KEY
  SELECT
    FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    BUILDING_HEIGHT
  FROM fac_building
) fb
  ON fb.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  -- fac_building does not expose STREET ADDRESS/CITY/STATE/ZIP in the provided DDL,
  -- but if another address table existed you would pull ADDRESS_PURPOSE='STREET' rows here.
  -- Preserve NULL columns to avoid breaking the selection; keep join by BUILDING_KEY.
  SELECT
    FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    NULL AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
    NULL AS CITY,
    NULL AS STATE,
    NULL AS ZIP
  FROM fac_building
) addr
  ON addr.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  -- aggregate room stats per building from fclt_rooms and fclt_rooms_hist
  SELECT
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    MIN(CASE
          WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(FLOOR, '')) = '' THEN NULL
          WHEN FLOOR RLIKE '^-?[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(FLOOR AS SIGNED)
          ELSE NULL
        END) AS MIN_FLOOR_LEVEL,
    MAX(CASE
          WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(FLOOR, '')) = '' THEN NULL
          WHEN FLOOR RLIKE '^-?[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(FLOOR AS SIGNED)
          ELSE NULL
        END) AS MAX_FLOOR_LEVEL,
    SUM(COALESCE(AREA, 0)) AS TOTAL_ROOM_AREA
  FROM (
    SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FLOOR, AREA FROM fclt_rooms
    UNION ALL
    SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FLOOR, AREA FROM fclt_rooms_hist
  ) fr
  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
) r
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY

WITH course_level_materials_agg AS (
  SELECT
    lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    lci.COURSE_NAME AS course_name,
    -- count distinct material identifier: prefer TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, otherwise catalog key
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY)) AS total_materials,
    -- extract digits-only year, treat empty/non-numeric as NULL, cast to unsigned for min/max
    MIN(
      CAST(
        NULLIF(
          REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(tm.`YEAR`, lrc.CATALOG_YEAR), '[^0-9]', ''),
        '') AS UNSIGNED)
    ) AS min_pub_year,
    MAX(
      CAST(
        NULLIF(
          REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(tm.`YEAR`, lrc.CATALOG_YEAR), '[^0-9]', ''),
        '') AS UNSIGNED)
    ) AS max_pub_year
  FROM library_course_instructor AS lci
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail AS lmd
    ON lmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog AS lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  LEFT JOIN tip_detail AS td
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
    AND td.TERM_CODE = lmd.TERM_CODE
    AND td.SUBJECT_ID = lmd.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN tip_material AS tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  WHERE lci.COURSE_NAME IS NOT NULL AND lci.COURSE_NAME <> ''
  GROUP BY lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, lci.COURSE_NAME
),
course_materials_status_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    ci.COURSE_NAME AS course_name,
    COALESCE(ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'UNKNOWN') AS material_status,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail md
  JOIN library_course_instructor ci
    ON md.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = ci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_material_status ms
    ON md.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  WHERE ci.COURSE_NAME IS NOT NULL AND ci.COURSE_NAME <> ''
  GROUP BY ci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, ci.COURSE_NAME, COALESCE(ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'UNKNOWN')
)
SELECT
  c.course_name,
  c.total_materials,
  c.min_pub_year AS min_publication_year,
  c.max_pub_year AS max_publication_year,
  -- aggregate statuses into a JSON object per course
  COALESCE(JSON_OBJECTAGG(s.material_status, s.cnt), JSON_OBJECT()) AS materials_status_counts
FROM course_level_materials_agg c
LEFT JOIN course_materials_status_counts s
  ON c.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = s.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
GROUP BY
  c.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
  c.course_name,
  c.total_materials,
  c.min_pub_year,

ORDER BY c.course_name

WITH

buildings_core AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    BUILDING_NUMBER,
    BUILDING_NAME,
    BUILDING_COUNTER
  FROM buildings
),
max_floor_value AS (
  SELECT MAX(BUILDING_COUNTER) AS max_floors FROM buildings_core
),
target_buildings AS (
  SELECT b.* FROM buildings_core b
  JOIN max_floor_value m ON b.BUILDING_COUNTER = m.max_floors
),
-- normalize employee office from Drupal directory; keep MIT_ID and OFFICE_LOCATION (as provided)
employees AS (
  SELECT
    MIT_ID,
    FULL_NAME,
    OFFICE_LOCATION,
    EMAIL_ADDRESS
  FROM drupal_employee_directory
  WHERE OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
),
-- moira list metadata
moira_lists AS (
  SELECT
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST
  FROM moira_list
  WHERE IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST IS NOT NULL
),
-- moira list detail contains subscriptions (MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER might be kerberos or MIT id; MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID exists)
-- we'll prefer MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID to join to employees.MIT_ID; fall back to MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER when it equals employees.KRB (not available)
subscriptions AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, ''), NULL) AS subscriber_mit_id,
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER,
    MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME
  FROM moira_list_detail
)
-- Final: join target buildings -> employees by matching OFFICE_LOCATION to building name or building number.
SELECT DISTINCT
  tb.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS MAILING_LIST_NAME
FROM target_buildings tb
-- match employees whose OFFICE_LOCATION corresponds to the building name or building number (case-insensitive)
JOIN employees e
  ON (
       LOWER(e.OFFICE_LOCATION) = LOWER(tb.BUILDING_NAME)
       OR LOWER(e.OFFICE_LOCATION) = LOWER(tb.BUILDING_NUMBER)
     )
-- require kerberos starting with 'c' : schema does not include explicit kerberos field in drupal_employee_directory.
-- We cannot apply kerberos filter reliably; but we can apply it when MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER contains kerberos if MIT_ID not kerberos.
-- The instructions say: "if kerberos field not listed, require kerberos field to exist; otherwise restrict" -> kerberos not present, so require kerberos field to exist.
-- Implemented by attempting to use MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER (which may contain kerberos) and filtering that to start with 'c' when MIT_ID not present.
JOIN subscriptions s
  ON (
       -- match subscription by MIT_ID when available in subscription row
       (s.subscriber_mit_id IS NOT NULL AND s.subscriber_mit_id = e.MIT_ID)
       -- otherwise, if MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER appears to be a kerberos (contains no '@' and not numeric), attempt to match by that to employees.MIT_ID
       OR (s.subscriber_mit_id IS NULL AND s.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER IS NOT NULL AND s.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = e.MIT_ID)
     )
JOIN moira_lists ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = s.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
-- Filters:
-- 1) Mailing lists must be MOIRA mailing lists and list name starts with 'a' (case-insensitive)
-- 2) Employee kerberos requirement: drupal_employee_directory does not include kerberos field; per instructions, require kerberos field to exist else the filter cannot be applied.
-- Because there is no kerberos field in drupal_employee_directory, we cannot safely filter employees by kerberos starting with 'c'. Therefore we instead enforce that the subscription member identifier (MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) starts with 'c' when subscriber_mit_id is NULL.
WHERE
  ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST IN ('1','t','true','Y','y','yes','Yes', 'TRUE') -- permissive check; keeps typical truthy values
  AND LOWER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'a%'
  AND (
    -- If subscription row gives a subscriber MIT id, attempt to filter that MIT id's kerberos cannot be determined -> per instruction, require kerberos field to exist; since it does not, we cannot filter; so include those rows.
    s.subscriber_mit_id IS NOT NULL
    -- OR when subscriber_mit_id is NULL, require the MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER string to start with 'c' (case-insensitive) as a proxy for kerberos starting with c
    OR LOWER(s.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) LIKE 'c%'
  )
ORDER BY tb.BUILDING_NAME ASC, ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME ASC

rows.question: For subjects offered this year in either the Fall or Spring term, list its department name, school name, subject ID, subject title, course level, total units, the term it is offered ('Spring' for Spring term and 'Fall' for Fall term), term description, the number of distinct instructors teaching in the Fall, and the number of distinct instructors teaching in the Spring.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH course_subjects_offered_cohort AS (
  SELECT
    `SUBJECT_ID`,
    `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    `SUBJECT_NUMBER`,
    `TOTAL_UNITS`,
    `IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR`,
    `IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM`,
    `FALL_INSTRUCTORS`,
    `IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM`,
    `SPRING_INSTRUCTORS`,
    `EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE`,
    `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
    `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` AS `KEEP_SUBJECT_KEY`
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
),
term_codes_reference AS (
  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `TERM_DESCRIPTION`,
    `TERM_START_DATE` /* kept for joinability if needed */
  FROM `academic_terms`
),
numbers AS (
  SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
  UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
)
SELECT
  c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  c.SUBJECT_ID,
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  LEFT(c.SUBJECT_NUMBER,3) AS COURSE_LEVEL,
  c.TOTAL_UNITS,
  CASE
    WHEN RIGHT(c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,2) = 'FA' THEN 'Fall'
    WHEN RIGHT(c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,2) = 'SP' THEN 'Spring'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS OFFERED_TERM,
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  -- count distinct instructors listed in FALL_INSTRUCTORS (comma-separated)
  (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(instructor_name))
    FROM (
      SELECT TRIM(
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(
          SUBSTRING_INDEX(IFNULL(c2.FALL_INSTRUCTORS,''), ',', numbers.n),
        ',', -1)
      ) AS instructor_name
      FROM numbers
      CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1) AS one
      WHERE IFNULL(c2.FALL_INSTRUCTORS,'') <> ''
        AND TRIM(
          SUBSTRING_INDEX(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(IFNULL(c2.FALL_INSTRUCTORS,''), ',', numbers.n),
          ',', -1)
        ) <> ''
      ) AS fall_names
    /* correlated reference to outer c row via alias c2 */
    /* MySQL doesn't allow aliasing outer table inside subderived's FROM clause, so use correlated subquery pattern below */
    JOIN (SELECT 1) AS dum ON 1=1
  ) AS FALL_INSTRUCTOR_COUNT,
  -- count distinct instructors listed in SPRING_INSTRUCTORS (comma-separated)
  (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(instructor_name))
    FROM (
      SELECT TRIM(
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(
          SUBSTRING_INDEX(IFNULL(c3.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS,''), ',', numbers.n),
        ',', -1)
      ) AS instructor_name
      FROM numbers
      CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1) AS one2
      WHERE IFNULL(c3.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS,'') <> ''
        AND TRIM(
          SUBSTRING_INDEX(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(IFNULL(c3.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS,''), ',', numbers.n),
          ',', -1)
        ) <> ''
      ) AS spring_names
    JOIN (SELECT 1) AS dum2 ON 1=1
  ) AS SPRING_INSTRUCTOR_COUNT
FROM course_subjects_offered_cohort c
LEFT JOIN term_codes_reference t
  ON c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE

rows.question: Group subjects by cluster type, department offering the subject, and the school name. For each group, list the cluster type, name of the department, school name, whether the department grants degrees, total number of subjects, total enrollment, and average enrollment. Exclude clusters or schools with no student data.

SELECT
  d.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE AS CLUSTER_TYPE,
  COALESCE(d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COALESCE(sd.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL) AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  CASE WHEN sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DEPARTMENT_GRANTS_DEGREES,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(d.SO_SUBJECT_ID, d.SUBJECT_ID)) AS TOTAL_SUBJECTS,
  SUM(se.ENROLLMENT_COUNT) AS TOTAL_ENROLLMENT,
  -- ensure decimal division
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(d.SO_SUBJECT_ID, d.SUBJECT_ID)) = 0
       THEN NULL
       ELSE SUM(se.ENROLLMENT_COUNT) / COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(d.SO_SUBJECT_ID, d.SUBJECT_ID)) + 0.0
  END AS AVERAGE_ENROLLMENT
FROM drupal_course_catalog d
LEFT JOIN sis_department sd
  ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN (
  -- aggregate enrollment by subject and term from subject_summary (subject enrollment column present there)
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_ID,
    TERM_CODE,
    SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,0)) AS ENROLLMENT_COUNT
  FROM subject_summary
  GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE
) se
  ON se.SUBJECT_ID = COALESCE(d.SO_SUBJECT_ID, d.SUBJECT_ID)
  AND se.TERM_CODE = d.SO_TERM_CODE
GROUP BY
  d.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE,
  COALESCE(d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME),
  COALESCE(sd.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL),
  CASE WHEN sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
HAVING
  SUM(se.ENROLLMENT_COUNT) IS NOT NULL

  SELECT
    `BUILDING_KEY`,
    `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
    `BUILDING_NAME`,
    `BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS`,
    `BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS`,
    `BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE`,
    `BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE`,
    `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
  FROM `buildings`
)
SELECT
  so.MEET_PLACE AS room_number,
  bb.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  bb.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
  bb.BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS AS building_city,
  NULL AS building_state,
  COALESCE(fr.AREA, bb.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, bb.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS area,
  so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS organization_name,
  fr.USE_DESC AS room_usage,
  so.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  so.COURSE_NUMBER AS course_level,
  sc.total_subjects AS total_number_of_subjects,
  mt.unique_meeting_times AS unique_meeting_times,
  ss.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units
FROM subject_offered so
JOIN buildings_basic_126 bb
  ON bb.BUILDING_NUMBER = SUBSTRING_INDEX(so.MEET_PLACE, ' ', 1)
LEFT JOIN fclt_rooms fr

  AND fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bb.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects

  GROUP BY SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
) sc
  ON sc.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY = so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT MEET_TIME) AS unique_meeting_times
  FROM subject_offered
  WHERE MEET_TIME IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
) mt
  ON mt.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY = so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
LEFT JOIN subject_summary ss
  ON ss.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY = so.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY
WHERE so.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
  AND so.MEET_TIME IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY so.TERM_CODE, bb.BUILDING_NUMBER, so.MEET_PLACE

rows.question: Consider only books cataloged on or after 2000. For each library material status and department, list the material status, department name, number of associated catalog items, and the total number of enrolled students in courses using those materials. Include subtotals for each material status and a grand total across all status (the corresponding status field is 'Grand Total').

WITH catalog_items AS (
  SELECT
    lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
    -- interpret create date as DATE
    STR_TO_DATE(lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS catalog_record_create_date,
    lrc.CATALOG_AUTHOR_NAME,
    lrc.CATALOG_TITLE,
    lrc.CATALOG_PUBLISHER,
    lrc.CATALOG_ISBN,
    lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER,
    lrc.CATALOG_CALL_NUMBER,
    lmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY AS MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
    tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    lmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
    lmd.TERM_CODE,
    lmd.SUBJECT_ID,
    lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    -- material type field: use CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE as date and assume material type indicated by CATALOG_CALL_NUMBER containing 'book' is NOT reliable.
    -- The DDL doesn't include an explicit material-type column; if TIP_MATERIAL exists join via ISBN to restrict to books where TIP_MATERIAL.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE='book' or other indicator.
    -- Fall back: treat records as books when there is a matching tip_material record (via ISBN) -- assume tip_material rows represent books.
    tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  FROM library_reserve_catalog lrc
  JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lmd
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  LEFT JOIN tip_material_status tms
    ON lmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_course_instructor lci
    ON lmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN tip_material tm
    ON ( (lrc.CATALOG_ISBN IS NOT NULL AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN <> '' AND tm.ISBN = lrc.CATALOG_ISBN)
         OR (lrc.CATALOG_ISBN IS NULL OR lrc.CATALOG_ISBN = '' ) AND tm.TITLE = lrc.CATALOG_TITLE )
  WHERE
    -- catalog date on or after 2000-01-01
    STR_TO_DATE(lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') >= '2000-01-01'
    -- restrict to materials that match tip_material (treat TIP_MATERIAL rows as books)
    AND tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
-- consolidate enrollments from subject_offered, tip_subject_offered, course_catalog_subject_offered and subject_summary
offering_enrolls AS (
  SELECT
    so.TERM_CODE,
    so.SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0) AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,''), 'Unknown') AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME
  FROM subject_offered so
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    tso.TERM_CODE,
    tso.SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0) AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,''), 'Unknown') AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME
  FROM tip_subject_offered tso
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    css.TERM_CODE,
    css.SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0) AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(css.DEPARTMENT_NAME,''), 'Unknown') AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered css
  LEFT JOIN subject_summary ss
    ON css.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
   AND css.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID
),
-- per catalog item, sum enrollments for matching term+subject
catalog_item_enrolls AS (
  SELECT
    ci.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
    COALESCE(SUM(oe.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS enrolls_for_item
  FROM catalog_items ci
  LEFT JOIN offering_enrolls oe
    ON ci.TERM_CODE = oe.TERM_CODE
   AND ci.SUBJECT_ID = oe.SUBJECT_ID
  GROUP BY ci.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
),
-- detail rows: material status + department
detail AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(ci.MATERIAL_STATUS, 'Unknown') AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(oe.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ''), 'Unknown') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ci.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
    COALESCE(SUM(cie.enrolls_for_item), 0) AS ENROLLED_STUDENT_COUNT,
    0 AS row_rank
  FROM catalog_items ci
  LEFT JOIN offering_enrolls oe
    ON ci.TERM_CODE = oe.TERM_CODE
   AND ci.SUBJECT_ID = oe.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN catalog_item_enrolls cie
    ON ci.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = cie.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  GROUP BY COALESCE(ci.MATERIAL_STATUS, 'Unknown'), COALESCE(NULLIF(oe.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ''), 'Unknown')
),
-- subtotals per material status
status_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    s.MATERIAL_STATUS,
    'Subtotal' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
    COALESCE(SUM(cie.enrolls_for_item), 0) AS ENROLLED_STUDENT_COUNT,
    1 AS row_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      COALESCE(ci.MATERIAL_STATUS, 'Unknown') AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
      ci.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
    FROM catalog_items ci
  ) s
  LEFT JOIN catalog_item_enrolls cie
    ON s.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = cie.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  GROUP BY s.MATERIAL_STATUS
),
-- grand total
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    'Grand Total' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ci.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
    COALESCE(SUM(cie.enrolls_for_item), 0) AS ENROLLED_STUDENT_COUNT,
    2 AS row_rank
  FROM catalog_items ci
  LEFT JOIN catalog_item_enrolls cie
    ON ci.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = cie.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
)
-- final union
SELECT
  MATERIAL_STATUS AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  CAST(CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT AS UNSIGNED) AS CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
  CAST(ENROLLED_STUDENT_COUNT AS UNSIGNED) AS ENROLLED_STUDENT_COUNT,
  CASE
    WHEN row_rank = 0 THEN 'detail'
    WHEN row_rank = 1 THEN 'status_subtotal'
    ELSE 'grand_total'
  END AS ROW_TYPE
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM status_subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM grand_total
) t
ORDER BY
  -- ensure Grand Total last
  CASE WHEN t.MATERIAL_STATUS = 'Grand Total' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END,
  t.MATERIAL_STATUS ASC,
  t.row_rank ASC,
  t.DEPARTMENT_NAME ASC

All numeric values should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators except the relative percentages which should be rounded to two decimal places.

WITH

valid_rooms AS (
  SELECT
    fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
    fr.BUILDING_KEY,
    fr.BUILDING_KEY        AS BUILDING_KEY_FOR_JOIN, -- keep key for joins/CTEs
    COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS BUILDING_NAME,
    fr.FLOOR                AS FLOOR_NUMBER,
    fr.ROOM                 AS ROOM_NUMBER,
    fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME    AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    fr.AREA                 AS AREA
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  LEFT JOIN buildings b
    ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
    ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE fr.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
    AND fr.AREA IS NOT NULL
    AND fr.AREA <> ''
    -- exclude non-numeric AREA values
    AND fr.AREA REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$'
),
-- Building-level totals (sum of room AREA and room counts) used for room and building percentages
building_area_totals AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    BUILDING_NAME,
    SUM(AREA) AS TOTAL_ROOM_AREA,
    COUNT(*) AS ROOM_COUNT
  FROM valid_rooms
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_NAME
),
-- Floor-level totals per building
floor_area_totals AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    BUILDING_NAME,
    FLOOR_NUMBER,

  FROM valid_rooms
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_NAME, FLOOR_NUMBER
),
-- Grand totals across all buildings
grand_totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(TOTAL_ROOM_AREA) AS GRAND_AREA,

-- 1) ROOM rows
SELECT

  vr.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  vr.FLOOR_NUMBER AS FLOOR_NUMBER,
  vr.ROOM_NUMBER AS ROOM_NUMBER,
  vr.OWNERSHIP_TYPE AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  vr.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  FORMAT(1,0) AS ROOM_COUNT,
  FORMAT(ROUND(vr.AREA),0) AS AREA,
  -- percentage of building total
  FORMAT(ROUND(vr.AREA / NULLIF(bat.TOTAL_ROOM_AREA,0) * 100, 2), 2) AS AREA_PERCENTAGE
FROM valid_rooms vr
JOIN building_area_totals bat
  ON vr.BUILDING_KEY = bat.BUILDING_KEY

UNION ALL

-- 2) FLOOR_SUBTOTAL rows (per building + floor)

  fat.FLOOR_NUMBER AS FLOOR_NUMBER,
  NULL AS ROOM_NUMBER,
  NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  FORMAT(fat.FLOOR_ROOM_COUNT,0) AS ROOM_COUNT,
  FORMAT(ROUND(fat.FLOOR_AREA),0) AS AREA,
  -- percent of building total
  FORMAT(ROUND(fat.FLOOR_AREA / NULLIF(bat.TOTAL_ROOM_AREA,0) * 100, 2), 2) AS AREA_PERCENTAGE
FROM floor_area_totals fat
JOIN building_area_totals bat
  ON fat.BUILDING_KEY = bat.BUILDING_KEY

UNION ALL

-- 3) BUILDING_SUBTOTAL rows
SELECT
  'BUILDING_SUBTOTAL' AS ROW_TYPE,
  bat.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  NULL AS FLOOR_NUMBER,
  NULL AS ROOM_NUMBER,
  NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  FORMAT(bat.ROOM_COUNT,0) AS ROOM_COUNT,
  FORMAT(ROUND(bat.TOTAL_ROOM_AREA),0) AS AREA,
  -- percent of grand total area
  FORMAT(ROUND(bat.TOTAL_ROOM_AREA / NULLIF(gt.GRAND_AREA,0) * 100, 2), 2) AS AREA_PERCENTAGE
FROM building_area_totals bat
CROSS JOIN grand_totals gt

UNION ALL

-- 4) GRAND_TOTAL row
SELECT
  'GRAND_TOTAL' AS ROW_TYPE,
  'ALL BUILDINGS' AS BUILDING_NAME,
  NULL AS FLOOR_NUMBER,
  NULL AS ROOM_NUMBER,
  NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  FORMAT(gt.GRAND_ROOM_COUNT,0) AS ROOM_COUNT,
  FORMAT(ROUND(gt.GRAND_AREA),0) AS AREA,
  -- grand total is 100.00%
  FORMAT(ROUND(100.00, 2), 2) AS AREA_PERCENTAGE
FROM grand_totals gt

-- Ordering: building asc, floor asc (NULLs last), within floor ROOM rows by room number asc,
-- and ensure subtotal rows appear after ROOM rows for that floor and building.
ORDER BY
  -- primary sort by building name (place 'ALL BUILDINGS' last by using high sort key)
  CASE WHEN BUILDING_NAME = 'ALL BUILDINGS' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
  BUILDING_NAME ASC,
  -- secondary: for grouping floors, we want ROOM then FLOOR_SUBTOTAL then BUILDING_SUBTOTAL then GRAND_TOTAL
  CASE ROW_TYPE
    WHEN 'ROOM' THEN 1
    WHEN 'FLOOR_SUBTOTAL' THEN 2
    WHEN 'BUILDING_SUBTOTAL' THEN 3
    WHEN 'GRAND_TOTAL' THEN 4
    ELSE 5
  END ASC,

  CASE
    WHEN FLOOR_NUMBER IS NULL THEN 999999
    WHEN FLOOR_NUMBER = '' THEN 999998
    ELSE CAST(FLOOR_NUMBER AS UNSIGNED)
  END ASC,
  -- for ROOM rows, order by ROOM_NUMBER; keep NULLs last
  CASE WHEN ROOM_NUMBER IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC,
  ROOM_NUMBER ASC

  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY STR_TO_DATE(at.TERM_START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') SEPARATOR ',') AS TERM_CODE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT at.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY) AS TERM_ROW_COUNT

  at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

rows.question: For each department, list the name of the department, the title of the TIP material associated with the department, author, ISBN, library term code, and whether it is available in the library reserves ('Available in Library' if yes and 'Not Available in Library' otherwise), the total number of instructors per library book for the department, the total number of materials available in the library for the department, and the total number of available materials across all departments.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH course_subjects_by_department AS (
  SELECT
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    `SUBJECT_ID`
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
),
-- Determine availability in library by matching ISBNs between TIP and library catalog.
-- Treat any non-null, non-empty matching catalog ISBN as indicating availability.
tip_with_dept AS (
  SELECT
    td.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`,
    td.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`,
    td.`ISBN` AS TIP_ISBN,
    tm.`TITLE` AS TIP_TITLE,
    tm.`AUTHOR` AS TIP_AUTHOR,
    td.`TERM_CODE` AS TIP_TERM_CODE,
    tso.`SUBJECT_ID`,
    tso.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE`
  FROM `tip_detail` td
  JOIN `tip_material` tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  JOIN `tip_subject_offered` tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
),
-- Library matches for TIP items (by ISBN and term/subject where appropriate)
tip_library_matches AS (
  SELECT
    t.*,
    lmd.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`,
    lmd.`LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY`,
    lmd.`TERM_CODE` AS LIB_TERM_CODE,
    lmd.`SUBJECT_ID` AS LIB_SUBJECT_ID,
    lrc.`CATALOG_ISBN`
  FROM tip_with_dept t
  JOIN `library_reserve_matrl_detail` lmd
    ON lmd.TERM_CODE = t.TIP_TERM_CODE
    AND lmd.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID
  JOIN `library_reserve_catalog` lrc
    ON lmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
    -- Match by ISBN when possible; if TIP ISBN is null/empty this join will not match
    AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN IS NOT NULL
    AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN != ''
    AND t.TIP_ISBN IS NOT NULL
    AND t.TIP_ISBN != ''
    AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN = t.TIP_ISBN
),
-- Distinct instructor identities for library reserve items (carry MIT_ID if available; fall back to name)
library_instructors AS (
  SELECT
    lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
    lci.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM `library_course_instructor` lci
),
-- Per department-material row: compute availability and department-level aggregates
dept_materials AS (
  SELECT
    td.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    csbd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    td.TIP_TITLE,
    td.TIP_AUTHOR,
    td.TIP_ISBN,
    td.TIP_TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE,
    -- availability: exists a library match for this TIP material (by ISBN + term + subject)
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM tip_library_matches tlm
      WHERE tlm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
    ) THEN 'Available in Library' ELSE 'Not Available in Library' END AS LIBRARY_AVAILABILITY,
    -- distinct instructors associated with this material within department (exclude NULL/empty)
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME, ''))
        FROM tip_library_matches tlm2
        JOIN library_course_instructor lci ON tlm2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
        WHERE tlm2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
          AND tlm2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = td.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
      ), 0
    ) AS DEPT_INSTRUCTOR_COUNT,
    -- per-department count of distinct TIP materials that are available in the library (will be aggregated over dept)
    NULL AS placeholder_for_dept_available_count
  FROM tip_with_dept td
  JOIN course_subjects_by_department csbd
    ON csbd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID
)
SELECT
  dm.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  dm.TIP_TITLE AS TIP_TITLE,
  dm.TIP_AUTHOR AS TIP_AUTHOR,
  dm.TIP_ISBN AS TIP_ISBN,
  dm.LIBRARY_TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE,
  dm.LIBRARY_AVAILABILITY AS LIBRARY_AVAILABILITY,
  dm.DEPT_INSTRUCTOR_COUNT AS DEPT_INSTRUCTOR_COUNT,
  -- total number of TIP materials for that department that are available in the library
  dept_counts.DEPT_AVAILABLE_MATERIAL_COUNT AS DEPT_AVAILABLE_MATERIAL_COUNT,
  -- overall total number of available TIP materials across all departments (same scalar repeated)
  global_counts.TOTAL_AVAILABLE_MATERIALS_ALL_DEPTS AS TOTAL_AVAILABLE_MATERIALS_ALL_DEPTS
FROM dept_materials dm
LEFT JOIN (
  -- compute per-department count of distinct TIP_MATERIAL_KEY that have a library match
  SELECT
    t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS DEPT_AVAILABLE_MATERIAL_COUNT
  FROM tip_with_dept t
  JOIN `library_reserve_matrl_detail` lmd
    ON lmd.TERM_CODE = t.TIP_TERM_CODE
    AND lmd.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID
  JOIN `library_reserve_catalog` lrc
    ON lmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
    AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN IS NOT NULL
    AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN != ''
    AND t.TIP_ISBN IS NOT NULL
    AND t.TIP_ISBN != ''
    AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN = t.TIP_ISBN
  GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
) dept_counts ON dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dm.DEPARTMENT_CODE
CROSS JOIN (
  -- global scalar: total distinct TIP materials that are available in the library across all departments
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS TOTAL_AVAILABLE_MATERIALS_ALL_DEPTS
  FROM tip_with_dept t
  JOIN `library_reserve_matrl_detail` lmd
    ON lmd.TERM_CODE = t.TIP_TERM_CODE
    AND lmd.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID
  JOIN `library_reserve_catalog` lrc
    ON lmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
    AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN IS NOT NULL
    AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN != ''
    AND t.TIP_ISBN IS NOT NULL
    AND t.TIP_ISBN != ''
    AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN = t.TIP_ISBN
) global_counts
WHERE dm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NOT NULL
-- Only include rows for departments that have at least one TIP material record (ensured by join to tip_with_dept)
ORDER BY dm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dm.TIP_TITLE

    -- try to parse MEET_TIME as start and end dates/times; assume format 'YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD' or 'YYYY-MM-DD'
    NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(so.MEET_TIME, ' to ', 1)),'') AS START_DATE_RAW,

    COUNT(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS total_subscribers
  FROM moira_list m
  JOIN moira_list_detail d
    ON m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  GROUP BY m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, m.IS_PUBLIC
),
-- resolve member to MIT_ID (if present) and to email; carry raw member identifier too
members_resolved AS (
  SELECT
    d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER,
    NULLIF(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') AS member_mit_id,
    d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS member_mit_id_raw,
    d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER AS member_string
  FROM moira_list_detail d
),
-- attach SIS student info from mit_student_directory using MIT_ID when possible, else try email match
member_depts AS (
  SELECT
    mr.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    mr.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER,
    -- prefer matching by MIT_ID if the raw MIT_ID field actually contains an MIT identifier that matches mit_student_directory.MIT_ID
    sd.DEPARTMENT AS department_code,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
    -- mark as SIS student if found in mit_student_directory
    CASE WHEN sd.FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_sis_student
  FROM members_resolved mr
  LEFT JOIN mit_student_directory sd
    ON (
         -- if there is a member_mit_id value that equals some field in student table, try matching; mit_student_directory has no MIT_ID column in schema,
         -- but may have EMAIL_ADDRESS or FULL_NAME; try email match first (most reliable), then FULL_NAME.
         mr.member_string IS NOT NULL AND mr.member_string = sd.EMAIL_ADDRESS
       )
    OR (
         mr.member_mit_id IS NOT NULL AND mr.member_mit_id = sd.EMAIL_ADDRESS
       )
    OR (
         mr.member_string IS NOT NULL AND mr.member_string = sd.FULL_NAME
       )
),
-- aggregate counts per department per list
dept_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    md.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(md.department_name, ''), NULLIF(md.department_code, '')) AS department_name,
    COUNT(*) AS members_in_dept,
    SUM(md.is_sis_student) AS sis_students_in_dept
  FROM member_depts md
  GROUP BY md.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, COALESCE(NULLIF(md.department_name, ''), NULLIF(md.department_code, ''))
),
-- pick top department per list with tie-break on alphabetical department_name; if department_name is NULL then those rows will be ranked after non-NULL
top_dept_per_list AS (
  SELECT
    da.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    da.department_name AS top_department_name,
    da.members_in_dept AS top_department_count,
    da.sis_students_in_dept AS top_department_sis_students,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY da.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
      ORDER BY da.members_in_dept DESC,
               -- NULLs last: use department_name IS NOT NULL desc then department_name asc to deterministically break ties
               (da.department_name IS NOT NULL) DESC,
               da.department_name ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM dept_aggregates da
),
top_lists AS (
  SELECT
    lc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    lc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    lc.IS_PUBLIC,
    lc.total_subscribers
  FROM list_counts lc
  WHERE lc.total_subscribers > 0
  ORDER BY lc.total_subscribers DESC, lc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
  LIMIT 100
)
SELECT
  tl.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  tl.total_subscribers,
  CASE
    WHEN tl.IS_PUBLIC IN ('1','Y','YES','TRUE','true','Yes','yes') THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS is_public,
  td.top_department_name,
  COALESCE(td.top_department_sis_students, 0) AS top_department_student_count
FROM top_lists tl
LEFT JOIN top_dept_per_list td
  ON tl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = td.MOIRA_LIST_KEY AND td.rn = 1
ORDER BY tl.total_subscribers DESC, tl.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

rows.question: Calculate the total assignable and non-assignable area for each building by summing up the respective areas of all its floors. For each building, list the building name, building number, total assignable area, total non-assignable area, and total room count, sorted in descending order of the total assignable area.

WITH floors AS (
  SELECT
    f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    COALESCE(f.EXT_GROSS_AREA, 0)   AS EXT_GROSS_AREA,
    COALESCE(f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 0)  AS ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    -- room count isn't stored on fclt_floor; use 0 here so NULLs don't break sums.
    0 AS ROOM_COUNT,
    f.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
  FROM fclt_floor f
),
building_floor_agg AS (
  -- aggregate per building from floors, treating NULLs as zero
  SELECT
    fl.BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(fl.ASSIGNABLE_AREA)                     AS SUM_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    SUM(fl.EXT_GROSS_AREA - fl.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS SUM_NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    SUM(fl.ROOM_COUNT)                          AS SUM_ROOM_COUNT
  FROM floors fl
  GROUP BY fl.BUILDING_KEY
)
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME                                 AS BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER                               AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  CAST(COALESCE(bfa.SUM_ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 0) AS SIGNED)       AS TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  CAST(COALESCE(bfa.SUM_NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 0) AS SIGNED)    AS TOTAL_NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  CAST(COALESCE(bfa.SUM_ROOM_COUNT, 0) AS SIGNED)            AS TOTAL_ROOM_COUNT
FROM buildings b
JOIN building_floor_agg bfa
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = bfa.BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA DESC

rows.question: For each instructor, list their name, the number of unique courses they teach, the total number of material assignments, average publication year, and number of distinct status, sorted by the number of unique courses in descending order.

WITH employee_directory_name_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    `MIT_ID`,
    `FIRST_NAME`,
    `LAST_NAME`,
    `FULL_NAME`,
    `EMAIL_ADDRESS`
  FROM `drupal_employee_directory`
),
course_sections_with_responsible_instructor AS (
  SELECT
    `SECTION_ID`,
    `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
    `SUBJECT_ID`,
    `SUBJECT_CODE`,
    `SUBJECT_NUMBER`,
    `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`,
    `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`,
    `TERM_CODE`
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
  WHERE `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` IS NOT NULL
     OR `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
),
-- aggregate material assignments by the keys we can join on (library course instructor key, term+subject)
materials_agg AS (
  SELECT
    m.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    m.TERM_CODE,
    m.SUBJECT_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS assign_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN catalog.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(catalog.CATALOG_YEAR AS SIGNED) ELSE 0 END) AS year_sum,
    SUM(CASE WHEN catalog.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS year_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS distinct_status_count
  FROM `library_reserve_matrl_detail` m
  LEFT JOIN `library_reserve_catalog` catalog
    ON m.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = catalog.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  GROUP BY
    m.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    m.TERM_CODE,
    m.SUBJECT_ID
)
SELECT
  -- prefer explicit RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME; otherwise use employee directory full name or composed first/last
  COALESCE(
    cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    ed.FULL_NAME,
    NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT(ed.FIRST_NAME, ' ', ed.LAST_NAME)), '')
  ) AS instructor_name,
  -- count distinct course identifiers per instructor: use SECTION_ID if present, otherwise MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, otherwise SUBJECT_CODE|SUBJECT_NUMBER
  COUNT(DISTINCT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(cs.SECTION_ID, ''),
      NULLIF(cs.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, ''),
      NULLIF(CONCAT(cs.SUBJECT_CODE, '|', cs.SUBJECT_NUMBER), '')
    )
  ) AS unique_course_count,
  -- total material assignments for all matched course identifiers
  COALESCE(SUM(md.assign_count), 0) AS total_material_assignments,
  -- average publication year excluding NULL/non-numeric years; return NULL if no numeric years
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(md.year_count) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(SUM(md.year_sum) / SUM(md.year_count), 2)
  END AS avg_publication_year,
  -- count of distinct material statuses across matched materials (we aggregated per md row, so sum those distinct counts)
  COALESCE(SUM(md.distinct_status_count), 0) AS distinct_status_count
FROM course_sections_with_responsible_instructor cs
LEFT JOIN employee_directory_name_lookup ed
  ON cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID
-- join aggregated materials by preferring SECTION_ID -> LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, otherwise by TERM_CODE+SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN materials_agg md
  ON (
       cs.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL
       AND cs.SECTION_ID <> ''
       AND md.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = cs.SECTION_ID
     )
  OR (
       (cs.SECTION_ID IS NULL OR cs.SECTION_ID = '')
       AND md.TERM_CODE = cs.TERM_CODE
       AND md.SUBJECT_ID = cs.SUBJECT_ID
     )
-- only include instructors that have at least one matched material assignment (per requirements)
WHERE md.assign_count IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY instructor_name
ORDER BY unique_course_count DESC

rows.question: For each sponsor, list the sponsor name, the number of IAP sessions hosted, and the number of unique subjects organized.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
course_subject_terms AS (
  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `SUBJECT_ID`,
    `SUBJECT_CODE`,
    `IS_OFFERED_IAP`,
    `TERM_DURATION`,
    `EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE`
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
),
iap_term_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `TERM_DESCRIPTION`,
    `TERM_START_DATE`,
    `TERM_END_DATE`,
    `IS_CURRENT_TERM`,
    `TERM_STATUS`,
    `ACADEMIC_YEAR`
  FROM academic_terms
),
-- Determine which TERM_CODE values should be treated as IAP.
iap_terms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TERM_CODE
  FROM (
    SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, IS_CURRENT_TERM FROM iap_term_lookup
    UNION ALL
    SELECT TERM_CODE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS IS_CURRENT_TERM FROM course_subject_terms
  ) t
  WHERE
    -- term lookup description or code mentions IAP
    (TERM_DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE '%IAP%')
    OR (TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND TERM_CODE LIKE '%IAP%')
    OR (IS_CURRENT_TERM IS NOT NULL AND IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'IAP')
)
SELECT
  s.SPONSOR_NAME AS SPONSOR_NAME,
  -- count distinct sessions from iap_subject_detail (use session key if present; fall back to combination)
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY, CONCAT(d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, '|', d.CREATE_DATE, '|', d.ACTIVITY_TITLE))) AS IAP_SESSION_COUNT,
  -- count distinct subject identifiers associated via course_subject_terms: prefer SUBJECT_ID, else SUBJECT_CODE.
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_CODE)) AS UNIQUE_SUBJECT_COUNT
FROM iap_subject_detail d
JOIN iap_subject_sponsor s
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN course_subject_terms c
  ON d.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
    -- keep join but do not force non-null here; subject counts use joined rows that match an IAP term
LEFT JOIN iap_term_lookup t
  ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN iap_terms it
  ON d.TERM_CODE = it.TERM_CODE
WHERE
  s.SPONSOR_NAME IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    -- term explicitly identified as IAP via the consolidated iap_terms list
    it.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
    -- OR the course_subject_terms row explicitly marks offering in IAP
    OR (c.IS_OFFERED_IAP IS NOT NULL AND c.IS_OFFERED_IAP IN ('Y','1','T','TRUE'))
    -- OR term lookup description/code contains IAP (covering cases where iap_terms might miss)
    OR (t.TERM_DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE '%IAP%')
    OR (t.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t.TERM_CODE LIKE '%IAP%')
  )
GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_NAME
ORDER BY IAP_SESSION_COUNT DESC, UNIQUE_SUBJECT_COUNT DESC

LEFT JOIN iap_subject_detail AS d
  ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY

  SELECT
    SECTION_ID,
    CASE
      WHEN IS_OFFERED_IAP IS NOT NULL
           AND TRIM(IS_OFFERED_IAP) <> ''
           AND UPPER(TRIM(IS_OFFERED_IAP)) IN ('Y','YES','TRUE','1','IAP')
        THEN 'IAP'
      WHEN SO_TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL

           AND UPPER(TRIM(SO_TERM_CODE)) = 'IAP'
        THEN 'IAP'
      ELSE NULL

  ON p.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = c.SECTION_ID

  AND c.IAP_CATEGORY IS NOT NULL

WITH cis AS (

    `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    -- cis has term-level instructor columns named FALL_INSTRUCTORS / SPRING_INSTRUCTORS only in schema provided
